answer: A bond is refunded only after 36 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The ridge counter is kept in atlas and harbor shows each reset. A hostile operator therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 36 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 283 aliases cost 105 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
